articles.title: Sources: Cardinals to cut QB Murray next week
articles.summary: The Cardinals have informed quarterback Kyler Murray that they intend to release him on the first day of the league year next Wednesday, barring a trade between now and then, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Monday.

articles.title: Colts place rarely used transition tag on QB Jones
articles.summary: The Colts place the rarely used transition tag on QB Daniel Jones, preserving their right to match any offer sheet in free agency.

articles.title: No tag for Hendrickson as time in Cincinnati ends
articles.summary: The Bengals did not use the franchise tag on defensive end Trey Hendrickson ahead of Tuesday's 4 p.m. deadline, making the 2024 All-Pro edge rusher available to sign with another team when free agency opens next week.

articles.title: Sources: Bears center Dalman retiring at age 27
articles.summary: Pro Bowl center Drew Dalman has informed the Bears that he's retiring at age 27 after four seasons with the Atlanta Falcons and one with Chicago, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.
